title: Studio, coming soon
why: A real public post captured on 2026-11-16. Counts are as captured; videos are stills.

post.text:
Every week brings another loud promise but nobody trust their agents. 

Look, we know. It’s your name on the door. When something goes wrong, you’re the one who gets the call.

We’re building studio with that responsibility in mind. Little helpers, carefully crafted for the work you will put your name to.

Coming soon.
